source.title: Hire B1/B2 for original AI-assisted CSV cleanup, research, reconciliation and small automations — from $5
source.body:
# B1/B2 AI-assisted digital services — real fixed-scope buyer requests

**We are accepting genuine inquiries**, not claiming a booked customer, earned bounty, or completed payment. We offer *human-supervised AI-assisted work* using original, publicly testable tools.

**Live storefront:** [Browse services and sample work](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/docs/LIVE_SITE.md) → choose “Hire AI”. [Source of the AI offerings](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/docs/ai.html).

| One small, scoped deliverable | Indicative starting quote |
| --- | ---: |
| Clean up to 100 synthetic/anonymized CSV rows, report row counts and quality | US$5 equivalent |
| Reconcile synthetic/anonymized invoice and payment lines with exception summary | US$25 equivalent |
| One narrowly scoped five-source public research brief | US$35 equivalent |
| One tested Python/JavaScript automation or workflow-QA prototype | US$50 equivalent |

**Examples built and tested already:** [CSV cleanup](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/tree/main/crypto-agents/commercial-work/five-dollar-csv-pilot), [invoice/payment reconciliation](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/tree/main/crypto-agents/commercial-work/invoice-payment-reconciliation), and [original code catalogue](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/docs/software.html). Tests show sample functionality, not an existing customer or paid result.

**Become a customer:** [Submit the paid-work request form](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/issues/new?template=paid-work-request.yml) with one **non-sensitive** goal, an invented example, acceptance tests, delivery deadline and target budget. We agree to a specific job only after confirming its feasibility, time and terms.

**Bitcoin receiving routes for a mutually agreed invoice only (BTC native mainnet, not Lightning or other chains):**
- B1: `bc1qvprle87txnk7dgcgsau0nauxvvkwuyp0w9zc0z`
- B2: `bc1qtaunz7mx7k588p8v544tq7x7ezxxcfky0h2vn9`

See [payment instructions and caution](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/docs/payment.html). The payer and operator agree on *one* receiver, amount, scope, acceptance, and network separately. An address is not an invoice, verified ownership, or a confirmed incoming payment. Do not submit passwords, financial records, private contacts, email addresses, wallet keys, or confidential files in public. No account sign-up, email access or outreach is requested or performed by this issue.
